ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to block the quote from having a contact different from account to which the quote belongs
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( !$User.ER_BypassVR__c, Contact.AccountId != Null, NOT( OR( Contact.AccountId = Opportunity.AccountId, Contact.AccountId = Opportunity.Account.ParentId, Contact.AccountId = Opportunity.Account.Parent.ParentId ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please choose a Contact that belongs to the same Account or Account hierarchy
